video_title: Stewie & Myles on the NBA Finals, Liberty Win Streak & When to Get Mad!

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's mastery of angles and low center of gravity
quotes.excerpt: he's always been a master of angles. Even at his height, even at his stature, his center of gravity's real low
quotes.quote: I have always been a fan of Jalen Brunson's game. He is someone who has always been a master of angles. Even at his height, even at his stature, his center of gravity is real low, and obviously he can get to wherever he wants with the ball. He just reads the floor really well.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's success as a pure point guard and scorer
quotes.excerpt: you're able to mix that with someone who's also a pure scoring threat, that's everything you want
quotes.quote: In today's day and age, a pure point guard is so hard to come across. There's only a few that are left in the league. You're able to mix that with someone who's also a pure scoring threat, that's everything you want in a floor general. I think that he's so successful because he gets to his spots. He's going to make sure he gets 25 to 30 shots a game, and his team allows him to be him.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's place in Knicks history and culture
quotes.excerpt: there's so much history in the Garden and guys that helped build that real Knicks culture
quotes.quote: There's so much history in the Garden and guys that helped build that real Knicks culture. Guys don't even talk about the Charles Oakleys of the world. He's not the greatest Knick ever, but he was part of that culture. You obviously have the Carmelo Anthonys of the world. I did not get to the heights that Jalen Brunson did, but he embodied that New York culture just because of who he was and where he was from. You obviously have the Patrick Ewings, Willis Reeds, Walt Fraziers.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: The mental and emotional exhaustion of the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: mentally, emotionally, you're exhausted, bro. Like, side-to-side movement. People don't realize just, like, basketball is not just a one-dimensional sport
quotes.quote: These guys are tired, bro. It's just what comes with it. I don't understand what people think when I say tired. It's not just sleepy tired. It's not just like I'm a little fatigued. Mentally, emotionally, you're exhausted, bro. Like, side-to-side movement. People don't realize just, like, basketball is not just a one-dimensional sport where you're sprinting up and down the floor. Like, sliding laterally and what not, playing on different linear planes, that takes a lot out of you.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' offensive impact and passing
quotes.excerpt: the thing that KAT has done offensively that's opened up his game so much, he's passing the shit out the ball
quotes.quote: I've always had respect for Karl-Anthony Towns. We're the same high school class, and we've had a few battles. The thing that KAT has done offensively that's opened up his game so much, he's passing the shit out the ball, bro. He's passing the ball so well. I think that he's always been someone who he wanted to be the primary scorer, he's an outside threat, he wants to shoot his threes, his step-backs. He's really answered the call when it comes to his role.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson's defensive impact on Bam Adebayo
quotes.excerpt: don't mention Mitchell Robinson in there, it's kind of throwing him off his balance, throwing off his feet
quotes.quote: Don't mention Mitchell Robinson in there, it's kind of throwing him off his balance, throwing off his feet. Mitch is huge. He's a great defender. He's someone who can kind of knock you off, and he knows his role. He's in there to get in your head.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart's role as an X-factor for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: a human example of X-factor is obviously Josh Hart. I don't even think he scored last game
quotes.quote: A human example of X-factor is obviously Josh Hart. I don't even think he scored last game, but he gets like the really big rebounds. He gets the really big stops. He goes down in transition and pushes. Like, he knows his role to a T.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of avoiding social media during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: y'all got to stay off y'all's phones. Y'all got to stay off social media, bro. You can't be watching the first takes
quotes.quote: For a young team, the very first thing I would say is y'all got to stay off y'all's phones. Y'all got to stay off social media, bro. You can't be watching the first takes, the whatever, the all these shows, bro. They're literally paid to talk about controversy. They're paid to put out a product out there and to keep people's attention, and it's very easily sit there and take that shit personally.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: The difference between playoff series and the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: we've had two days to pass. That's the difference between the finals and all these other playoff series
quotes.quote: One, you have to forget about the last two games, because we've had two days to pass. That's the difference between the finals and all these other playoff series. In other playoff series, it's game off, game off, game off. Now it's game, you're off for two days, now you have to sit here and think about what you did for two days.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: The need to attack the paint against the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: offensively, we have got to try to find a way to break that plane, to break that free throw line
quotes.quote: Offensively, we have got to try to find a way to break that plane, to break that free throw line, because once you get those guys, so I know from playing against New York, they're really paint-oriented as a team. So if you do get into the paint, they over-help and they're going to over-commit, and then that's when you start getting perimeter threes and what not.
